name: Enemy Posture System - POST05 general anti-stagger below posture 100 (TEST)
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. POST05 0.5.4 (POST05-GENERAL): a confirmed non-lethal hit on a Bokoblin (Blue/Red/Black, native or Bokoblin Expansion) whose posture stays below 100 after that hit no longer starts the DAMAGE flinch or the BIG_DAMAGE knock-down, in ANY normal state (waiting, walking, searching, chasing, attacking, recovering). It still loses HP, gets posture, hit SE/hit-stop and cooldown stay vanilla. The final reaction of damage_check is undone exactly (mode/state/previous mode, the two timers, HeadLock and the body sphere set bits back to their pre-hit values); an idle/walking/watching Bokoblin instead notices Link exactly like the native slingshot reaction (FIND 1). The hit that brings posture to 100 and later hits keep the native reaction (POST06 knock-down not implemented). Lethal hits, Finish, scripted/death/water/fall states stay vanilla. One PRE+POST hook, PRE always continues. Replaces POST05 0.5.3 and older: never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
